title: Comfort Club Tier Changes: Mid-Term Upgrades and Downgrades at Renewal
content:
Desk guidance on moving a Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement between tiers.

## Mid-term upgrades
- **Status.** A mid-term upgrade is processed only while the agreement status is active.
- **Target tier.** A mid-term upgrade is accepted only into a tier that allows mid-term upgrades into it and that ranks above the current tier.
- **Systems.** Every enrolled system must meet the new tier's age limit on the upgrade date, and the systems enrolled may not exceed the new tier's maximum number of systems.
- **Annual agreements.** The upgrade proration charge is the new tier's annual dues for the enrolled systems less the current tier's annual dues for the same systems, multiplied by the unused full months from the upgrade date to the term end and divided by twelve, rounded to the cent half up. An upgrade with no unused full month posts no proration charge.
- **Monthly agreements.** No proration is charged; the new tier's monthly dues start with the next billing month.
- **Visits.** Visit grants for the upgrade follow the maintenance visit rules.

**Unused full months** are the whole calendar months remaining, counted as complete month-to-month steps from the upgrade date that end on or before the term end; a partial month counts as zero.

## Tiers that cannot be entered mid-term
A move into a tier that does not allow mid-term upgrades into it takes effect only at renewal, as the tier written for the new term; that tier's covered-repair benefit and waiting period then start with that term's first coverage grant.

## Downgrades
Downgrades never take effect mid-term. The member requests a downgrade at renewal, which the member confirms, and the lower tier applies from the next renewal provided the number of systems covered does not exceed that tier's maximum. When it would, the downgrade cannot be accepted until systems are removed at renewal.

## Worked example (hypothetical annual agreement, two systems)
Comfort Club Silver to Comfort Club Gold on 20 June 2025, term ending 31 December 2025.
- Gold dues for the two systems: first-system rate 249.00 plus additional-system rate 169.00, giving 418.00. Silver dues for the same systems: 199.00 plus 139.00, giving 338.00. Difference: 80.00.
- Unused full months: steps ending 20 July, 20 August, 20 September, 20 October, 20 November and 20 December all fall on or before 31 December; the step to 20 January does not. That is 6 months.
- Proration charge: 80.00 multiplied by 6 and divided by twelve, giving 40.00 USD.

## Points of judgement
- An upgrade dated 10 December on a term ending 31 December leaves no complete month: no proration charge.
- A past due agreement asking to upgrade: not processed while past due.
